overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that litellm.BadRequestError could be imported and raised at module load time in litellm/decisions/call.py, but this creates a circular import because litellm itself needs to import from the decisions module.
why_it_breaks: When the Admin UI calls GET /guardrails/ui/add_guardrail_settings, the server attempts to import litellm.decisions.call, which imports litellm at the top level. However, litellm's own initialization likely imports from the decisions module (as evidenced by the router initialization in candidate 2 importing decisions functions), creating a circular dependency that raises an ImportError and returns HTTP 500.
